primary_provider: Hong Kong Lands Department / CSDI Building
height_definition: Original BaseHeight and TopHeight elevations retained; publisher height_m ignored and recomputed during validation
verification: Whole frozen file SHA256 matches distributor LFS object. Full ID/geometry/elevation comparisons performed; four example elevations checked independently against the official API. These are not independent height measurements.
source_observation_dates: not retained by distributor; retrieval date is not a survey date
primary_height_policy: structural component TopHeight minus BaseHeight; ground-to-top retained separately
integration_match_policy: Exact unique BuildingCSUID, compatible non-podium/podium type, valid source geometry and footprint IoU >=0.95; retain local footprints
